marketing_description: The Lithonia Lighting Semi-Regressed Wafer™ Downlight (WF4REGSWW590CRIMW) delivers 2000 lm from a single 75 W LED (E26) while drawing only 24 W at 120 V, 0.2 A, 60 Hz, and is dimmable for flexible lighting control. Its canless, wafer‑style design fits a 4‑1/4 in recessed opening, with a flat‑face trim, steel white housing, air‑tight and IC‑rated construction, and a 90° beam angle across color temperatures from 2700 K to 5000 K with CRI 90. The unit includes the LED bulb and meets standard recessed mounting requirements.
